signals.thesis: Nvidia shares fell roughly 5% in premarket trading after the company's board launched an independent investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The probe follows Huang's admission to an affair with an executive suspected of working for Chinese intelligence and growing bipartisan demands in Congress for him to testify.
signals.title: Nvidia shares slide 5% as board probes CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy

signals.thesis: A stronger-than-expected U.S. October employment report showed hiring broadening across white-collar, manufacturing, and transportation sectors, strengthening the case for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in December. The data counters earlier bond market positioning that had anticipated fading odds of additional Fed rate increases.
signals.title: Broadening U.S. October job gains raise odds of December Fed rate hike

signals.thesis: China's Producer Price Index rose 5.7% in October, surpassing the 5.3% Reuters consensus estimate and marking the highest wholesale inflation reading in more than four years even as consumer inflation slowed.
signals.title: China October wholesale inflation hits four-year high of 5.7% as consumer measure slows

signals.thesis: Following earlier oil market declines on hopes for Middle East negotiations, President Donald Trump confirmed the U.S. carried out minor strikes on Iran as two missiles hit Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, before stating that renewed U.S. strikes are highly unlikely if talks over Iran's nuclear program and the strait progress. Separately, a Houthi attack damaged the Saudi Aramco Tower in Riyadh's financial district, about a month after deadly strikes hit the capital's airport.
signals.title: U.S. conducts minor strikes on Iran and Houthis hit Riyadh's Aramco Tower amid nuclear talks

signals.thesis: Berkshire Hathaway spent a record $9.6 billion repurchasing its own shares in the third quarter, more than doubling its buyback pace as CEO Greg Abel deployed the conglomerate's cash reserves. However, third-quarter net income fell 28% due to smaller investment gains and weaker insurance underwriting profits.
signals.title: Berkshire Hathaway posts record $9.6B Q3 share buybacks as net income drops 28%
